name: Terrazzo
description: An eighties terrazzo: sharp chips of bright stone in every color and size, scattered thick across a pale ground.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); clip-path: polygon(@calc(50 + 0.96 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.3 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + 0.22 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.98 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.73 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.68 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.96 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.3 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.22 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.98 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + 0.73 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.68 * @r(28, 50))%); transform: translate(@r(-28%, 28%), @r(-28%, 28%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)) scale(@r(.5, .95)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); clip-path: polygon(@calc(50 + 0.96 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.3 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + 0.22 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.98 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.73 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + 0.68 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.96 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.3 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + -0.22 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.98 * @r(28, 50))%, @calc(50 + 0.73 * @r(28, 50))% @calc(50 + -0.68 * @r(28, 50))%); transform: translate(@r(-35%, 35%), @r(-35%, 35%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)) scale(@r(.25, .55)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
